problem.statement: Solo travellers cannot cancel a booking online and must contact support, which delays refunds and creates avoidable support work.

users.need: Cancel a booking without contacting support and understand the refund outcome immediately.

goals.statement: A traveller can cancel an eligible booking in the web flow and see the refund amount before confirming.

non_goals.statement: Changing the dates of a booking is out of scope for the first release.

requirements.title: Online cancellation
requirements.statement: The booking page offers a cancel action for bookings whose policy allows it.
acceptance_criteria: An eligible booking shows the cancel action and completes cancellation exactly once.
A non-cancellable booking explains why cancellation is unavailable.

requirements.title: Refund preview
requirements.statement: Before confirmation the traveller sees the refund amount and the time it will take.
acceptance_criteria: The preview shows the exact amount and currency of the expected refund.
The confirmed cancellation records the displayed amount with the booking.

requirements.title: Cancellation notification
requirements.statement: A successful cancellation sends an email confirming the booking and refund state.
acceptance_criteria: The email is queued after the cancellation transaction commits.
A failed email does not roll back an accepted cancellation.

nfrs.statement: The cancellation action responds within two seconds at the 95th percentile.
acceptance_criteria: A load test at the documented baseline stays under two seconds p95.

constraints.statement: The first release uses the existing booking database and payment provider.

evidence.claim: Support handles cancellation requests manually today.
Product requires a refund preview before the traveller confirms.

assumptions.statement: Eligibility rules are already stored with each booking.

risks.statement: The payment provider may confirm a refund late, so the cancelled state can precede the refund state.
risks.mitigation: Record a pending refund state and reconcile provider callbacks idempotently.

decisions.question: Should partial refunds be supported in the first release?
decisions.decision: No; only the policy-calculated full eligible amount is shown.

sources.excerpt: Support currently handles cancellation requests manually.
Show the refund amount before confirming and do not support partial refunds yet.
